name: Magistrate Sevren
summary: In Brill, Magistrate Sevren directs the settlement's defense and sends newcomers to steady the lands around the Undercity.

sections.title: Town Magistrate of Brill
sections.body: From Brill's town hall, Magistrate Sevren directs civil and strategic affairs in the lands north of the Undercity. New Forsaken arriving in Tirisfal Glades find local crises waiting. Sevren sends adventurers to restore order, secure ruined places, and suppress threats in the surrounding hills.

sections.title: Securing the Graves
sections.body: The Tirisfal dead and their burial grounds are among Magistrate Sevren's chief concerns. Scourge-aligned Rot Hide gnolls, graverobbers, and rogue undead threaten the graves and Sylvanas Windrunner's growing dominion. Sevren seeks to reclaim ancestral tombs such as the Agamand Family Crypt and keep deserters or uncooperative forces from undermining Forsaken authority.

faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren directs Brill from its town hall and oversees Forsaken affairs in the region. He sends adventurers arriving from Deathknell to help the fledgling realm.

faq.q: Where can Magistrate Sevren be found?
faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren can be found inside the Town Hall at the center of Brill, in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What threats does Magistrate Sevren deal with?
faq.answer: Sevren faces threats across Tirisfal Glades, including Scourge-aligned Rot Hide gnolls who rob graves, Scourge remnants that desecrate crypts, and rogue undead who refuse allegiance to Lady Sylvanas.
Magistrate Sevren is loyal to the Forsaken and governs Brill on behalf of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the Undercity.

faq.q: Why does Sevren send adventurers to the family crypt?
faq.answer: Undead and scavengers overrun the Agamand family crypts. Sevren sends adventurers to secure these ancestral resting places and keep enemies from exploiting them.

faq.q: Does Sevren have ties to the Undercity leadership?
faq.answer: Yes. Sevren frequently works with agents and officials from the Undercity. Once adventurers prove their competence in Brill, he directs them deeper into the capital.

angles.text: As a newly liberated Forsaken leaving Deathknell, you meet the civic face of Sylvanas's realm in Magistrate Sevren. He gives you your first major assignments to safeguard your homeland.
As an ally of the Horde arriving in Tirisfal, you find Sevren coordinating efforts to pacify the region against bandits, Scourge remnants, and rebel factions.
